# KIROSHI: Smart Tourist Safety Monitoring & Incident Response System

> Real-time geospatial telemetry monitoring, multi-signal predictive risk analysis, and automated emergency SOS dispatch platform.

## System Overview
KIROSHI is an enterprise-grade mission-critical tourist safety and incident response ecosystem designed for municipal authorities, park rangers, emergency responders, and tourists.

## Core Capabilities
- **Geofence Containment & Tracking**: High-precision polygon geofence monitoring with automatic ENTER/EXIT boundary detection and PostGIS / Shapely spatial evaluation.
- **Multi-Signal Predictive Risk Engine**: Real-time scoring combining geofence hazards, route deviation meters, speed anomalies, and telemetry freshness into explainable SAFE/LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL categories.
- **Emergency Incident State Machine**: Deterministic lifecycle (TRIGGERED -> TRIAGE -> VERIFIED -> DISPATCHED -> RESOLVED / DISMISSED) with role-based dispatch authorization and responder coordination.
- **Tourist Mobile SOS**: 3-second rapid emergency SOS broadcast featuring client-side fallback and offline survival guidance.

## Architecture
- **Backend**: FastAPI modular monolith with PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS 3.4, SQLAlchemy ORM, Alembic migrations, and WebSocket pub/sub.
- **Authority Dashboard**: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind/Vanilla CSS, Lucide icons, responsive dark tactical theme.
- **Mobile Application**: Flutter cross-platform client with background GPS telemetry collection and emergency UI.

## Main Endpoints
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login`: Issue role-scoped JWT tokens
- `POST /api/v1/location`: Telemetry ingestion and live broadcast
- `POST /api/v1/zones`: Polygon boundary creation and hazard classification
- `GET /api/v1/risk/active`: Real-time fleet risk snapshot
- `POST /api/v1/sos`: Tourist emergency SOS activation
- `GET /api/v1/incidents`: Incident query with status and severity filters
- `POST /api/v1/incidents/{id}/transition`: State machine transition with audit logging
